payload.explanation: Use version 1.0.1 of the Codex Crash Diagnostic Model Picker so click-time dispatch validates the process identifier, excludes coredump metadata from the initial prompt, rejects control characters in displayed names, and treats later retrieved metadata as untrusted evidence.

reference.source_description: MIT-licensed public plugin revision verified on the repository's main branch

payload.effects: The plugin replaces the crash watcher's user-service command through a namespaced drop-in. Codex users receive a model and supported-reasoning picker; other agents use Omarchy's packaged action.
payload.rollback: Disable the plugin to route the service back to the packaged crash watcher, then use the plugin lifecycle cleanup before removal. This does not establish that the packaged diagnosis path has the same hardening.
payload.validation_plan: Validate the plugin and scripts, run the security and behavioral suites, exercise enable, disable, cleanup, reinstall, Codex cancellation and selection, and non-Codex fallback, then inspect the active user-service command.

activation.details: Enable the plugin and restart the user crash-watcher service so its namespaced drop-in becomes active.
